project_type: React 19 / Vite 7 / TypeScript 5.9 SPA + Supabase Postgres multi-tenant backend
build_system: Vite 7 with Bun as package manager. NEVER use npm/yarn/pnpm. bun run build is BANNED (4GB RAM). Use bun run typecheck instead.
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner (node:test + node:assert/strict). Command: `bun run test` which runs `node --experimental-loader ./src/tests/resolve-alias.js --test "src/tests/critical/*.test.js"`. New tests MUST go in src/tests/critical/ to be picked up.
build_command: N/A — bun run build is banned. Use bun run typecheck for type verification.
verification_instructions:
1. bun run audit:load (MUST run first — checks for dangerous load patterns)
2. bun run typecheck (checks TypeScript, no emit)
3. bun run test (runs src/tests/critical/*.test.js with Node.js test runner)
4. supabase db push (required for every migration; fix errors and re-push until success)
5. After db push: run `supabase db shell` then `NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';` to flush PostgREST cache
environment_constraints: Windows (win32/pwsh). No Docker. No local Supabase stack. Hosted project ref: xqlpekpkbszpdgtuwybh. Supabase CLI 2.112.0. Token stored in Windows Credential Manager (not ~/.supabase/access-token). Run `supabase db push` directly — do not start local stack.
contribution_requirements: Read AGENTS.md before touching any code. Core guardrails: never modify Calculations.ts, never modify PDF renderers, never modify Item Library files (src/domain/cps, src/modules/item-library). Every migration must be pushed with `supabase db push`. Surgical changes only.
key_patterns:
1. TenantClient RPC calls: `tenantClient.rpc('fn_name', { p_param: value })` — returns `{ data, error }`. See src/lib/audit.ts for full pattern.
2. Provisioning helpers: public._prov_install_*(p_schema_name) pattern — installer function called in DO block for all entity_* schemas AND in provision_entity(). See 20260828000001_item_library_tenant_objects.sql for the exact template with __SCHEMA__ / __SCHEMA_TEXT__ placeholders.
3. Tenant RPC bodies use __SCHEMA__ (replaced with quote_ident(p_schema_name)) and __SCHEMA_TEXT__ (replaced with raw schema name string). __SCHEMA_TEXT__ replaced first to avoid prefix collision.
4. SQL STABLE functions inside tenant schemas do NOT use SECURITY DEFINER — caller-rights functions inherit session RLS. See get_item_suggestions in 20260828000001.
5. Migration rank pattern from get_item_suggestions: CASE WHEN normalized = needle THEN 1000 WHEN LIKE needle||'%' THEN 900 WHEN LIKE '%'||needle||'%' THEN 700 ELSE 0 END.
6. Tests read migration files from disk using node:fs readdirSync/readFileSync. Tests assert SQL patterns with assert.match(sql, /regex/). No live DB required.
7. DocumentQueryContext adapter pattern: adapters have `fetcher(query, ctx)` returning Promise<any[]>. tenantClient comes from ctx.tenantClient via requireFetchClient(ctx).
8. useEntity() hook provides { tenantClient, entity } where tenantClient.rpc(...) routes to tenant schema.
9. All existing migrations use standard (non-CONCURRENT) CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. CONCURRENTLY is not used anywhere and is not safe inside supabase db push transactions.
10. pg_trgm does NOT exist in any migration yet — must be enabled via CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm in the migration.
directory_structure: src/app/ — App bootstrap. src/components/ — UI components (query/, loading/, search/ NEW). src/config/moduleAdapters.ts — adapter registry for DocumentQueryContext. src/context/DocumentQueryContext.tsx — centralized list query state. src/domain/ — business logic (search/ NEW for types.ts). src/hooks/ — React hooks. src/lib/ — core utilities (tenantClient.ts, audit.ts, formatters/). src/modules/ — module adapters (search/ NEW for documentSearchService.ts). src/pages/ — route pages. src/supabase/ — Supabase client. src/tests/critical/ — tests run by `bun run test`. supabase/migrations/ — ordered SQL migrations. Tenant schemas: entity_<workspace>_<entity> e.g. entity_bigdrops-main_main. tenant_master_template — structure-only schema cloned for new tenants.
